intro: Farm, fish, explore, and build the coziest kitty island paradise!
description:
Welcome to Kitty Farm Island!

Start your journey as a cute little kitty and transform a tiny island into a thriving farming paradise.

Plant crops, harvest fresh produce, earn coins, and unlock exciting new areas as your farm grows bigger and bigger. Explore three unique island regions, from peaceful green fields to sandy deserts and snowy winter landscapes.

Hire adorable kitty farmers to help with the work and upgrade them to become even more productive. Expand your storage, improve your animals, and build the ultimate farming empire.

Take a break from farming with relaxing mini-games:
• Catch fish in peaceful waters
• Shake fruit trees and gather fresh harvests
• Milk cows for valuable products
• Collect eggs from chickens
• Shear fluffy sheep for wool
• Upgrade animals to increase production

Every harvest brings new opportunities. Earn more money, unlock new territories, discover new resources, and watch your island community grow.

Whether you enjoy farming, collecting, upgrading, or simply relaxing with cute cats, Kitty Farm Island offers a cozy and rewarding adventure for players of all ages.

Features:
• Cute kitty-themed farming adventure
• Three unique island environments
• Crop planting and harvesting
• Hire and upgrade kitty workers
• Animal care and production systems
• Multiple relaxing mini-games
• Progressive island expansion
• Simple controls and casual gameplay
• Family-friendly experience

Build, harvest, explore, and create the ultimate kitty farming paradise!
